description: This file is a shell script designed to handle telemetry data upload in a device management context. It manages uploading telemetry data via various connection methods including direct, HTTP, and TFTP, with logic for retries, queuing failed uploads, and selecting appropriate endpoints. It also handles environment setup, endpoint configuration, and ensures only one instance runs at a time.

methods.name: getTelemetryEndpoint
methods.description: Fetches and sets the telemetry upload URL based on device RFC settings or response file.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file indicating current script instance.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Determines if direct connection is currently blocked.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Detects whether Codebig feature is available and accessible, sets connection preferences.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload telemetry data directly over HTTP or TFTP, with retries and fallback.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Attempts to upload telemetry data via Codebig connection using signed requests, with retries.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Retrieves erouter IPv4 address via dmcli.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Retrieves erouter IPv6 address via dmcli.
